description: Reverb built from eight comb filters and four all-pass filters, with the filter tunings opened up as controls

params.text: Scales the length of every comb and all-pass filter together
Sets the comb filters' feedback, 0.8 to 0.99
Sets how much high end is lost each time the sound goes round the comb filters
Sets how much shorter each all-pass filter is than the one before it, in twelfths from equal down to a fifth
Sets how much shorter each comb filter is than the one before it, in twelfths from equal down to a fifth
Crossfades between the dry input and the reverb

inputs.text: Adds to the SIZE knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the TIME knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the DAMP knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the AP RATIO knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the COMB knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the MIX knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held between fully dry and fully wet

outputs.text: The dry and reverberated signals mixed, with the DC offset taken out and the result clamped at 10V either way
